biography.value: Void Gales open with Cyclone Manifestation (2 actions) to dominate terrain, then spend the third action on World Wind against the summoner's designated priority target. Subsequent turns run two World Wind strikes against priority targets and a third on Skyfire when enemies cluster — or reverse that order if a formation presents itself first. Primordial Vortex handles anyone attempting to hold ground between turns. A Void Gale does not need tactical guidance — it has existed long enough that it understands what victory requires in most situations and moves toward it. What it needs from the summoner is target designation, ally identification, and confirmation of the rules of engagement. Everything else it handles.

system.attacksNotes:
World Wind [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 20 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 15 damage (9 + 6 Str) + 5 lightning damage (Half DR); target pushed 30 feet and knocked Prone; no save.
  • Margin 2: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 lightning damage; Prone + Stunned; all creatures within 15 feet of target take 10 lightning damage from discharge.
  • Margin 3: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 lightning damage + Stunned + Blinded until end of their next turn from the lightning discharge at face range.

Skyfire [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 200 ft, 20-foot diameter.

  • Margin 1:: 20 lightning damage (17 + 3 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 20 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned.
  • Margin 3: 20 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned + knocked Prone; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Primordial Vortex: Creatures within 30 feet that are not designated must make Fortitude [Hard] saves at the start of their turn. Failure: pushed 20 feet, knocked Prone, and Deafened for 1 minute. The summoner and designated allies are immune. Cyclone Manifestation (1/day) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, the Void Gale establishes a sustained cyclone in a 40-foot diameter centered on itself. For 1 minute, all non-designated creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain, must make Fortitude [Hard] saves each round or become Restrained by wind. Ranged ### Attacks into or through the area add 2 to both dice. The Void Gale moves normally through its own cyclone. Lightning Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 8 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical lightning damage while within 60 feet. Eye of the Storm: The Void Gale designates up to 6 creatures within 30 feet as protected. Protected creatures are immune to Primordial Vortex and cannot be pushed or knocked Prone by any of the Void Gale’s ### Attacks or abilities. Designation changes as a [Free] action. Momentum Defense: While the Void Gale has moved at least half its fly speed this turn, ### Attacks against it add 1 to both attack dice. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Void Gale fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
